title: Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. translated_title: 超越模仿的推理：面向视频大语言模型的观测条件化蒸馏
translated_abstract: 推理蒸馏为将强大的视频大语言模型的时序推理能力迁移至开源学生模型提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，由于采用了不同的视频采样流程，教师模型与学生模型可能会从同一视频中构建出不同的时序观测。在教师模型观测下有效的推理轨迹，可能依赖于学生模型无法获取的证据，因而无法基于学生模型的观测直接执行。我们将这一问题形式化为条件目标不匹配，从而揭示了“推理获取-执行鸿沟”。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了一个“获取到执行”的框架：首先将教师模型的推理轨迹蒸馏为学生的推理先验，然后在多种观测条件下进一步优化该先验的执行能力。我们进一步引入了执行感知的参考正则化，当现有先验……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了教师与学生视频大语言模型因视频采样流程差异导致的“推理获取-执行鸿沟”，并提出“获取到执行”蒸馏框架与执行感知参考正则化，使学生的推理先验能在自身观测条件下真正可执行。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap caused by differing video sampling pipelines between teacher and student Video-LLMs, and proposes an acquisition-to-execution distillation framework with Execution-Aware Reference Regularization to make distilled reasoning priors executable under the student's own observations.
